title: vacancy_short_code helper duplicates gdpr_integration_test's fetch_vacancy_short_code
detail: Identical short_code-by-id lookup now exists as a private helper in two integration test files. AGENTS.md's DRY rule (extract when logic repeats 2+ places) and the file's own convention of shared helpers living in integration/test_db.gleam favour one shared helper.
recommended_fix: Add a pub vacancy_short_code (or fetch_vacancy_short_code) to server/test/integration/test_db.gleam next to query_text, and call it from both draft_integration_test.gleam and gdpr_integration_test.gleam.
